answer: Rotating witness quorum. Each agent task requires a quorum drawn by a yarrow-derived beacon after the agent commits its claim, so attackers cannot precompute which peers will judge them. An attacker gains nothing by pre-registering many identities, since selection depends on post-commitment entropy. Each sybil identity must independently pay to keep a responsive quill endpoint online and answer a liveness pulse within the window; missing it voids that identity's claim and forfeits its setup cost.
